title: Rolandstraße, Wedel
description:
We are going on an adventure and we are looking for someone to take care of our home the next 2 years.
Ground floor: Two small studies with equipped computer workstations including height-adjustable desks, guest toilet, storage room with washing machine, and an open-plan kitchen with plenty of space and lots of children's toys. Access to the garden is via a conservatory, which is more suitable for use as an outdoor area.
Upstairs, we have 3 bedrooms and a large bathroom with a bathtub.
The lease is limited to 1 or 2 years. We will be returning home in 2028.
The garage has storage space and a dryer, as well as a covered parking space for the car in front.

title: Schulstraße, Wedel
description:
This freshly furnished 1.5-room apartment in Wedel offers everything you need for a comfortable start: modern, brand-new furniture, a fully equipped kitchen, high-speed internet, and your own underground parking space.
The highlight: direct access from the living room to the sunny terrace and shared garden use – perfect for relaxing outdoors.
Located centrally opposite the picturesque Mühlenteich, shops, restaurants, medical facilities, and the S-Bahn station are all within walking distance. Nearby attractions include the Hamburg Marina (2,000 berths, the largest non-tidal marina in Northern Europe) and the Willkomm Höft ship greeting station.
Ideal for project workers, young professionals, or companies looking for a high-quality alternative to a hotel. Enjoy a bright, quiet home with a warm and welcoming atmosphere, and excellent connections to Hamburg. Just pack your bags and move in – everything is ready!

title: Schulauer Straße, Wedel
description:
Property Description
This high-quality residential property impresses with modern features and contemporary living comfort. Spacious living areas with a fireplace, underfloor heating throughout, and roller shutters in all rooms create an attractive and comfortable living atmosphere.
A particular highlight is the generous roof terrace, offering an appealing outdoor area with a high level of usability. An EV charging station emphasizes the forward-looking and sustainable character of the property.
Two stylishly designed modern bathrooms as well as a high-quality fitted kitchen with sophisticated equipment meet the highest living standards.

Location
Attractive residential location close to the River Elbe: The Elbe dyke and the Wedeler Au nature area are within a few minutes’ walk or cycling distance, offering excellent recreational and leisure opportunities. Wedel town center, with a wide range of shopping facilities, restaurants, medical practices and schools, is easily accessible. Excellent transport connections via Wedel S-Bahn station (S1 line to Hamburg) as well as the B431, providing convenient access to Hamburg.

Additional Information
Heating costs are not included in the ancillary costs and are charged separately based on consumption.
